title: Validation scan of the Gran Sasso physics laboratory

tellings.quote: >> So we did uh uh measurements of the Gran Sasso d'Italia physical laboratory.
In the case of the Gran Sasso, I used a different processing technique. It was like an experiment.
tellings.difference: Adds that the scan used an experimental processing technique and dates it to 2024.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Filippo's own scan of the Gran Sasso laboratory.

as_told.title: Gran Sasso laboratory scan with an experimental processing technique

plain: The scientist Filippo Biondi, known for scanning beneath the pyramids of Egypt, says he took measurements of the physics laboratory at Gran Sasso d'Italia in Italy to test his scanning method on a known site. He tells it as his own work, adding on a later episode that he did it in 2024 and used a different, experimental processing technique, "like an experiment," which matters because a working test there would lend weight to his pyramid scans.
